concerns.text: FR-001 requires the dataset to contain “outcome, predictors, covariates” and an assumption about “post‑task anxiety/rumination variables”, but the GateMem benchmark does not define any of these fields. As written the requirement cannot be implemented nor verified.

SC-001 states that an “Access Control score (unauthorized exposure rate) is measured against the Baseline”, but does not specify the exact numerator and denominator (e.g., unauthorized exposures / total requests, or / allowed requests). Without a concrete formula the success criterion is not measurable.

SC-002 mentions a “Task Utility score (success rate)” but does not define how success is determined (e.g., exact match, BLEU, human‑annotated correctness). The lack of a precise metric definition makes the criterion ambiguous.

SC-005 refers to a “Forgetting compliance rate” without describing the calculation (e.g., number of deletion requests correctly denied / total deletion requests). The metric needs an explicit definition to be testable.
